verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's first-party docs describe shareable scheduling links. Invitees can view their own calendar overlaid on yours and pick a time in a couple of clicks, and links can be hosted on a custom domain or embedded on a website. Together this delivers self-serve booking without email back-and-forth. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that host availability syncs live from connected calendars (only implied by calendar-overlay and calendar-slot language), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
